title: helianthemum vulgare subsp. serpillifolium
intro: Helianthemum vulgare subsp. serpillifolium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum vulgare subsp. serpillifolium include soothing and calming effects, which may be useful in treating anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
